Name: Community Center Checklist
Author: Skyking2020
Description:
[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51903/51903-1788817845-1549849332.jpg[/img][/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]An interactive checklist to help you complete the Community Center quest by showing you what's needed, what you have in inventory, and how many you need. Included is a customization menu to configure the checklist to your needs. Works with alternate Community Center lists and mods.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download the mod and unzip into your game's mod folder or using your mod manager.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod displays a checklist on the side of the screen showing you what's needed to complete the Community Center quest and the Jojo Mart quest. This works with the alternate Community Center option and any mod that would change what is needed to complete those quests. The checklist is customizable. Display only what you want to see, be it the room or rooms you want to see, quantity you have in stock, etc. This mod will check what you have in your personal inventory and what you have in chests.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Currently pressing F7 will open the options menu. You can change the hotkey at any time.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew 1.6[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color][/size]
